parts.text: Show all active ODIN/ALIS maintenance work orders from maintenance_work_orders where work_order_status != 'COMPLETED' ordered by priority ascending using execute_maintenance_sql, and include the Excel / Google Sheets Spreadsheet Card and CSV download link.

Executed execute_maintenance_sql on antig-dave.ukd_f35_sustainment_demo.maintenance_work_orders returning 6 active work orders (including ZM151 work orders WO-2026-88401, WO-2026-88402), rendered as an Excel / Google Sheets Spreadsheet Card with status badges (🟡 PMC-M, 🔴 NMC-S (MICAP)), formula footer (=COUNTA, =SUM), and authenticated GCS CSV download link [📥 Download .CSV (Excel / Google Sheets)](https://storage.cloud.google.com/antig-dave-f35-staging-europe-west1/exports/).

Query phm_bit_fault_events using execute_maintenance_sql to triage active PHM/BIT fault codes, Can-Not-Duplicate (cnd_flag = TRUE) pilot-report-only events, and unlinked PHM advisories across the F-35B fleet, and render the Excel / Google Sheets Spreadsheet Card and CSV download link.

Executed execute_maintenance_sql on antig-dave.ukd_f35_sustainment_demo.phm_bit_fault_events surfacing ZM151 fault events HRC-2710-88A (CRITICAL_GROUNDING, linked to WO-2026-88401) and HRC-5330-000-NONE (PILOT_REPORT_ONLY_NO_BIT with cnd_flag=True on subsystem 53-30 canopy latch, linked to WO-2026-88402), along with unlinked PHM advisories awaiting work order generation, rendered as an Excel / Google Sheets Spreadsheet Card with formula footer (=COUNTA, =SUM) and authenticated GCS CSV download link.

Run a multi-table JOIN between maintenance_work_orders and work_center_tooling_and_sqep using execute_maintenance_sql to audit active work orders against SQEP technician certifications, QAR inspector availability, and special support equipment calibration status, and render the Excel / Google Sheets Spreadsheet Card and CSV download link.

Executed multi-table JOIN via execute_maintenance_sql across antig-dave.ukd_f35_sustainment_demo.maintenance_work_orders and work_center_tooling_and_sqep, matching 6 active work orders including ZM151 work orders WO-2026-88401 (READY_TO_DISPATCH, requires special tool EHA-HYD-2710) and WO-2026-88402 (requires special tool JTD-53-30-T14 Canopy Rigging Pin & Feeler Gauge Kit), while flagging bay dispatch bottlenecks caused by EXPIRED_OUT_OF_CAL tools (LO-IR-BLANKET-04, BLOCKED_TOOL_OUT_OF_CAL) and missing QAR coverage (BLOCKED_NO_QAR_ON_SHIFT), rendered as an Excel / Google Sheets Spreadsheet Card with GCS CSV export link.
Check RAF Marham electro-hydrostatic actuator fatigue hours against regional depot stock and tomorrow morning's sortie schedule. Include inline Vega-Lite charts and recommend any necessary tail swap.

Tail ZM151 (Electro-Hydrostatic Actuator S/N ACT-99812-F, NSN 1680-01-619-4821) is at 1,000.4 flight hours, breaching the 1,000.0-hour condemnation limit (status PMC-M). Regional depot UK-Marham Supply Hub (DEP-UK-01) holds 4 units on hand with 2 reserved for 30-day demand and an 18.0-hour shipping ETA. Morning sortie SRT-MAR-20261103-01 (Flt Lt Henderson / Callsign VIPER-1) should be swapped from ZM151 to serviceable spare tail ZM154 (842.0 flight hours, status MC), with two inline Vega-Lite v5 charts rendered.

We have an F-35B (ZM152) at RAF Marham reporting a sticky canopy catch during pre-flight lock verification, but there are zero BIT fault codes logged. Search the JTD technical manuals and 5-year cross-service maintenance logs for the root cause and corrective action.

Cross-service terminology normalizes 'sticky canopy catch' to 'canopy latch binding' on subsystem 53-30 with bit_fault_associated=false. Per DOC-01 (JTD-F35-53-30-01-A, Forward Canopy & Latching Mechanism Mechanical Rigging & Lubrication), verify forward canopy lock pin engagement clearance (0.020-0.035 in) and apply MIL-PRF-81322 grease to the forward actuator pivot pin. Per DOC-02 (NALC-USMC-VMFA211-2023-0842, USMC sister squadron narrative log), inspect the forward canopy roller channel for cured RTV silicon sealant debris obstructing the latch roller path without triggering proximity sensor BIT faults.
